entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Occasional snow showers to about 1000 metres, lowering to 800 metres this afternoon and to 700 metres in the evening. 1 to 3 cm could accumulate above 800 metres about and south of the summit, mostly after 4pm. Lesser amounts further down.
